title: ‘True feeling of Indian citizenship’: For Poonam, it lies in Aadhaar, PAN as Pak-born woman gets nationality
description: Poonam and her brother Gagan had arrived in India amid the surge of militancy in Pakistan’s Swat region, sent by their father, a wholesale food trader from Mingora, to escape threats from armed groups. The siblings first moved between Delhi and Rampur, where Poonam later married local businessman Puneet Kumar in 2005 and started a family. She maintained contact with relatives across the border until 2013, when the absence of a valid Pakistani ID prevented her from renewing her passport, cutting off her visits.
